propositions: Comment identity must be based on persistent HLC-to-Jira-comment-ID map rather than normalized body equality to prevent collisions and false duplicate detection
Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment API calls must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via _update_one_dispatch_comments) and persisted in binding_store
Outbound and inbound comment sync must use separate authoritative identity sources (outbound map vs jira_comment_id field) with append-only semantics and no cross-direction interference
Comment bodies must be rendered through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-before-encode ordering, and the a32a _resolve_codec injection must be migrated from IdentityCodec to the real codec
Comment sync must be idempotent and crash-durable, with write-ahead saves preventing duplicate re-posts after map write failures
Normalized comment body comparison must remain as a demoted secondary skip behind the primary map-key and jira_comment_id guards
